name: Sushant Mudalgi

projects.name: OpsPilot
projects.summary: An agentic RAG copilot for on-call incident response. Given an alert, it searches runbooks and past postmortems, checks deploys, metrics, and logs through tool calls, and returns a diagnosis that cites its evidence.
projects.outcome: Hybrid search (BM25 + dense vectors, fused with RRF) reached 1.000 hit@5 and 1.000 MRR on a golden dataset, versus 0.909 MRR for either method alone, enforced by a CI gate. A deterministic verifier drops made-up citations, logs are screened for prompt injection, and actions that change production need human approval.

projects.name: DealRadar
projects.summary: A full-stack price tracker for Amazon products: paste a product link, and it scrapes the price, charts its history, and flags a deal when the price drops below your target.
projects.outcome: Flask and MySQL backend where database triggers and stored procedures detect price drops, a scraper that handles deals, price ranges, and hidden prices, Chart.js price-history charts, and deal news pulled from RSS feeds.

projects.name: DNS simulation
projects.summary: A local DNS simulation built with socket programming in Python 3.

projects.name: COVID-19 tracker
projects.summary: A React app that fetches real-time COVID-19 confirmed, recovered, and death counts, globally and by country.

points: Joined Takeda directly after supporting its data engineering team through EY.
Developed and maintained 15+ production PySpark pipelines on Databricks across North America and Europe, powering analytics and regulatory reporting under strict data-compliance requirements.

Built secure data ingestion with Databricks Unity Catalog and AWS (S3, DMS, Step Functions, Lambda), including scheduled snapshot delivery from Databricks Delta Marketplace so downstream teams always had fresh data.
Implemented 15 real-time and batch PySpark pipelines processing 200 to 300 GB from SQL Server, SFTP, SharePoint, Heroku, and third-party vendors, in modular, object-oriented Python.
Designed 30+ Delta Lake tables for fast queries and pharmaceutical reporting, with ingestion automated through AWS DMS, EventBridge, Step Functions, and S3.
Migrated orchestration from AWS Step Functions to Tidal, cutting workflow costs by 25% and scheduling 10+ Databricks workflows with clearer job dependencies.
Designed fact and dimension tables in Amazon Redshift and connected the warehouse to Tableau, delivering data models and dashboards for enterprise reporting.
Built ETL jobs in Talend and AWS Glue with reusable, object-oriented Python transformations, and led the migration of Talend jobs to AWS Glue.
Applied machine learning (K-Means, Mean Shift, linear regression, XGBoost) in Python to surface business insights from transactional data.
Built the React.js front end of a digital platform with real-time interactions for 5,000+ monthly active users, backed by a MongoDB document store.
